questions.question: Mirror used by dentist to see large images of teeth of patients is ______.
questions.solution:
**The Correct Answer is __Option 4__ i.e __Concave Mirror__.**

 
 

 Zigzag Mirror
 
 
 
• The mirror set at a 45-degree angle on one side.
 
• It creates optical illusions as one pass by,
 
 
 
 

 Convex Mirror
 
 
 
• Gives an erect and diminished image.
 
• Used in sunglasses.
 
• Used in vehicles.
 
• Used in a magnifying glass.
 
 
 
 

 Plane Mirror
 
 
 
• It is a mirror with a flat reflective surface.
 
• They are used in periscopes.
 
• Used in an overhead projector.
 
• Used in car wing mirrors.
 
• Used in microscopes.
 
 
 
 

 Concave Mirror
 
 
 
• Gives a magnified and erect image.
 
• Used in telescopes.
 
• Shaving mirrors.
 
• Used in Torches, and headlights of vehicles.
 
• Used by the dentist to see large images of teeth of patients.

questions.concept: Ecology and Functions of an ecosystem
questions.question: What percentage of energy is transmitted from one trophic level to another in a food chain?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **1**, i.e __**10**__.

 
• The sequence of eating and being eaten produces a transfer of food energy and it is known as the **food chain**.
 
• A sequence of organisms that feed on one another, form a food chain.
 
• The **amount of energy** **decreases** as it passes from **one trophic level to another trophic level**.
 
• As little as **10 percent of the energy** at any trophic level is **transferred to the next level **and the **rest is lost largely through the metabolic process as heat.**

questions.question: Son River which is one of the largest southern tributaries of Ganga originates in which state?
questions.solution:
**The Correct Answer is __Option 4__ i.e __Madhya Pradesh__.**

 
• The **Ganges, or Ganga**, is a trans-boundary river of Asia which flows through India and Bangladesh.
 
• Major left-bank tributaries include Gomti River, Ghaghara River, Gandaki river, and Kosi river; major right-bank tributaries include Yamuna river, Son river, and Damodar.
 
• The **Kosi River** is known as the **"Sorrow of Bihar"**.
 
• **Son River** is the second largest of the Ganges' southern tributaries after Yamuna River.
 
• It originates near **Amarkantak** in **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• Chief tributaries of Son river are **Rihand** and the **North Koel**.

questions.question: Who is the head of the State and is the highest formal authority in India?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is Option **3** i.e **__President__**.

 
• **President** is the **head of the state** and is the highest formal authority in the country.

 
 
• He is the **commander-in-chief of the Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• **Draupadi Murmu** is the present President of India.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister** is the **head of the government** and actually exercises all governmental powers.
 
 
• He takes most of the decisions in the Cabinet meetings.
 
 
 
• **Vice President** acts as **President** in the absence of the president due to **death, resignation, impeachment, or other situations**.
 
• **Vice President of India** is also **ex officio Chairperson** of the **Rajya Sabha.**
 
• Vice President of India is the second-highest formal authority after President of India.
 
• **Parliament** is the supreme authority in making laws in India.
 
• **Indian Parliament** comprises of **President, Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha**.
